# Personal Site Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Build a personal website with writings, photography, and an about page using Astro, deployed on Cloudflare Pages.

**Architecture:** Static site generated by Astro v6 from Markdown content (writings) and TypeScript data (photo collections). Content collections with Zod schema for type-safe frontmatter. Lightweight client-side scroll-reveal animations via Intersection Observer. Client-side tag filtering for writings.

**Tech Stack:** Astro v6, TypeScript, CSS (no framework), Zod (schema validation), Cloudflare Pages (deployment)

- [ ] **Step 1: Create content config with writings collection**

Write `src/content.config.ts`:

```typescript
import { defineCollection } from 'astro:content';
import { glob } from 'astro/loaders';
import { z } from 'astro/zod';

const writings = defineCollection({
  loader: glob({ base: './src/content/writings', pattern: '**/*.md' }),
  schema: z.object({
    title: z.string(),
    date: z.coerce.date(),
    tags: z.array(z.string()).default([]),
    hero: z.string().optional(),
    description: z.string().optional(),
  }),
});

export const collections = { writings };
```

Write `src/content/writings/sample-writing.md`. Replace the hero image path with a real image later:

```markdown
## Getting Started

Astro is a fantastic framework for content-driven websites. Here's why I chose it for my personal site.

### Zero JS by Default

Pages ship as static HTML with zero JavaScript. Only add interactivity where you need it.

### Content Collections

Type-safe Markdown with Zod validation — frontmatter errors are caught at build time, not runtime.

### Image Optimization

Built-in `<Image />` and `<Picture />` components handle responsive images, formats, and lazy loading.
```

```typescript
export interface Photo {
  src: string;
  title: string;
}

export interface PhotoCollection {
  slug: string;
  title: string;
  cover: string;
  photos: Photo[];
}

export const collections: PhotoCollection[] = [
  {
    slug: "oregon-coast",
    title: "Oregon Coast",
    cover: "/photos/placeholders/coast-cover.jpg",
    photos: [
      { src: "/photos/placeholders/coast-01.jpg", title: "Haystack Rock" },
      { src: "/photos/placeholders/coast-02.jpg", title: "Mist at Cannon Beach" },
    ],
  },
  {
    slug: "mountains",
    title: "Mountains",
    cover: "/photos/placeholders/mtn-cover.jpg",
    photos: [
      { src: "/photos/placeholders/mtn-01.jpg", title: "Alpine Meadow" },
      { src: "/photos/placeholders/mtn-02.jpg", title: "Summit View" },
    ],
  },
];

export function getFeaturedPhotos(): Photo[] {
  return collections.flatMap((c) => c.photos).slice(0, 7);
}

export function getCollectionBySlug(slug: string): PhotoCollection | undefined {
  return collections.find((c) => c.slug === slug);
}

export function getAllTags(photos: Photo[]): string[] {
  return [...new Set(photos.map((p) => p.title))];
}
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Create BaseLayout**

Write `src/layouts/BaseLayout.astro`:

```astro
---
import Nav from '../components/Nav.astro';
import '../styles/global.css';

export interface Props {
  title?: string;
  page?: string;
}

const { title, page } = Astro.props;
---

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
    <title>{title ? `${title} — tim forrer` : 'tim forrer'}</title>
    <link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="/favicon.svg" />
  </head>
  <body>
    <Nav currentPage={page} />
    <main>
      <slot />
    </main>
  </body>
</html>

<script>
  // Scroll-reveal observer — watches for .reveal elements
  const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
    (entries) => {
      entries.forEach((entry) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.classList.add('revealed');
        }
      });
    },
    { threshold: 0.15 }
  );

  document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach((el) => observer.observe(el));

  // Scroll-driven fade out/in for paired elements
  const fadeOutEl = document.querySelector('.fade-out-on-scroll');
  const fadeInEl = document.querySelector('.fade-in-on-scroll');

  if (fadeOutEl && fadeInEl) {
    const onScroll = () => {
      const scrollY = window.scrollY;
      const triggerPoint = window.innerHeight * 0.3;
      const progress = Math.min(scrollY / triggerPoint, 1);

      fadeOutEl.style.opacity = String(1 - progress);
      fadeOutEl.style.transform = `translateY(${-20 * progress}px)`;

      fadeInEl.style.opacity = String(progress);
      fadeInEl.style.transform = `translateY(${20 * (1 - progress)}px)`;

      if (progress >= 1) {
        fadeOutEl.classList.add('scrolled');
        fadeInEl.classList.add('visible');
      } else {
        fadeOutEl.classList.remove('scrolled');
        fadeInEl.classList.remove('visible');
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
  }
</script>
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Create TagFilter component**

Write `src/components/TagFilter.astro`:

```astro
---
export interface Props {
  tags: string[];
}

const { tags } = Astro.props;
---

<div class="tag-filter" data-component="tag-filter">
  <div class="mode-toggle">
    <span class="mode-label">Filter:</span>
    <button class="mode-btn active" data-mode="or">OR</button>
    <button class="mode-btn" data-mode="and">AND</button>
  </div>
  <div class="tags">
    {tags.map((tag) => (
      <button class="tag" data-tag={tag}>{tag}</button>
    ))}
  </div>
</div>

<style>
  .tag-filter {
    font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }

  .mode-toggle {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--text-muted);
  }

  .mode-btn {
    padding: 2px 8px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 12px;
    font-size: 11px;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.2s;
  }

  .mode-btn.active {
    background: var(--accent);
    color: #fff;
    border-color: var(--accent);
  }

  .tags {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 6px;
  }

  .tag {
    padding: 4px 10px;
    background: #f0f0f0;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 12px;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.2s;
  }

  .tag.active {
    background: var(--accent);
    color: #fff;
  }
</style>

<script>
  const root = document.currentScript?.closest('[data-component="tag-filter"]');
  if (!root) throw new Error('TagFilter: missing data-component root');

  const modeBtns = root.querySelectorAll('[data-mode]');
  const tagBtns = root.querySelectorAll('[data-tag]');
  let currentMode = 'or';

  modeBtns.forEach((btn) => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      modeBtns.forEach((b) => b.classList.remove('active'));
      btn.classList.add('active');
      currentMode = btn.dataset.mode ?? 'or';
      dispatchFilter();
    });
  });

  tagBtns.forEach((btn) => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      btn.classList.toggle('active');
      dispatchFilter();
    });
  });

  function dispatchFilter() {
    const activeTags = [...tagBtns]
      .filter((b) => b.classList.contains('active'))
      .map((b) => b.dataset.tag ?? '');

    const event = new CustomEvent('tag-filter', {
      detail: { mode: currentMode, tags: activeTags },
    });
    root.dispatchEvent(event);
  }
</script>
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Create the Writings listing page**

Write `src/pages/writings/index.astro`. This page shows only the most recent writing above the fold, with the remaining grid and tag filter scroll-revealed:

```astro
---
import BaseLayout from '../../layouts/BaseLayout.astro';
import WritingCard from '../../components/WritingCard.astro';
import TagFilter from '../../components/TagFilter.astro';
import { getCollection } from 'astro:content';

const allPosts = await getCollection('writings');
allPosts.sort((a, b) => b.data.date.getTime() - a.data.date.getTime());

const latestPost = allPosts[0];
const remainingPosts = allPosts.slice(1);

const allTags = [...new Set(allPosts.flatMap((p) => p.data.tags))];
---

<BaseLayout page="writings" title="Writings">
  <section class="writings-page">
    {latestPost && (
      <div class="latest reveal">
        <WritingCard post={latestPost} />
      </div>
    )}

    <div class="below-fold reveal">
      <TagFilter tags={allTags} client:idle />

      {remainingPosts.length > 0 ? (
        <div class="grid">
          {remainingPosts.map((post) => (
            <div class="grid-item" data-tags={post.data.tags.join(',')}>
              <WritingCard post={post} />
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : remainingPosts.length === 0 && latestPost ? null : (
        <p class="empty">No more writings yet.</p>
      )}
    </div>
  </section>
</BaseLayout>

<script>
  const tagFilter = document.querySelector('[data-component="tag-filter"]');
  const gridItems = document.querySelectorAll('.grid-item');

  if (tagFilter && gridItems.length > 0) {
    tagFilter.addEventListener('tag-filter', ((e: CustomEvent) => {
      const { mode, tags } = e.detail;

      gridItems.forEach((item) => {
        const itemTags = (item.dataset.tags ?? '').split(',').filter(Boolean);

        if (tags.length === 0) {
          (item as HTMLElement).style.display = '';
          return;
        }

        const matches =
          mode === 'or'
            ? tags.some((t: string) => itemTags.includes(t))
            : tags.every((t: string) => itemTags.includes(t));

        (item as HTMLElement).style.display = matches ? '' : 'none';
      });
    }) as EventListener);
  }
</script>

<style>
  .writings-page {
    padding-bottom: 40px;
  }

  .latest {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    margin-bottom: 32px;
  }

  .latest :global(.card) {
    max-width: 300px;
  }

  .grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    gap: 16px;
  }

  .empty {
    color: var(--text-muted);
    font-size: 14px;
    text-align: center;
    margin-top: 40px;
  }

  @media (min-width: 600px) {
    .grid {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    }
  }

  @media (min-width: 800px) {
    .body {
      max-width: 800px;
    }
    .grid {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    }
  }
</style>
```

```astro
---
import BaseLayout from '../../layouts/BaseLayout.astro';
import { getCollection, getEntry, render } from 'astro:content';
import type { GetStaticPaths } from 'astro';

export async function getStaticPaths() {
  const posts = await getCollection('writings');
  return posts.map((post) => ({
    params: { slug: post.id },
    props: { post },
  }));
}

const { post } = Astro.props;
const { Content } = await render(post);

const readingTime = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((post.body?.length ?? 0) / 1000));
---

<BaseLayout title={post.data.title}>
  <article class="writing">
    <header class="header">
      {post.data.hero && (
        <img class="hero-img" src={post.data.hero} alt="" />
      )}
      <h1 class="title">{post.data.title}</h1>
      <div class="meta">
        <time datetime={post.data.date.toISOString()}>
          {post.data.date.toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
            month: 'long',
            day: 'numeric',
            year: 'numeric',
          })}
        </time>
        <span class="sep">·</span>
        <span>{readingTime} min read</span>
      </div>
      <div class="tags">
        {post.data.tags.map((tag: string) => (
          <span class="tag">{tag}</span>
        ))}
      </div>
    </header>
    <div class="content">
      <Content />
    </div>
  </article>
</BaseLayout>

<style>
  .writing {
    max-width: 640px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding-bottom: 60px;
  }

  .header {
    margin-bottom: 32px;
  }

  .hero-img {
```

Write `src/pages/photos/index.astro`:

```astro
---
import BaseLayout from '../../layouts/BaseLayout.astro';
import { photoCollections, getFeaturedPhotos } from '../../data/photos';

const featured = getFeaturedPhotos();
---

<BaseLayout page="photos" title="Photos">
  <section class="photos-page">
    <div class="featured-label">Featured</div>

    <div class="masonry fade-out-on-scroll">
      {featured.slice(0, 1).map((photo) => (
        <div class="masonry-item tall">
          <img src={photo.src} alt={photo.title} />
        </div>
      ))}
      {featured.slice(1, 3).map((photo) => (
        <div class="masonry-item">
          <img src={photo.src} alt={photo.title} />
        </div>
      ))}
      {featured.slice(3, 5).map((photo) => (
        <div class="masonry-item wide">
          <img src={photo.src} alt={photo.title} />
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>

    <div class="collections-section fade-in-on-scroll">
      <div class="collections-label">Collections</div>
      <div class="collections-grid">
        {photoCollections.map((col) => (
          <a href={`/photos/${col.slug}`} class="collection-card">
            <div class="collection-cover">
              <img src={col.cover} alt={col.title} />
            </div>
            <div class="collection-title">{col.title}</div>
          </a>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>
</BaseLayout>

<style>
  .photos-page {
    padding-bottom: 40px;
  }

  .featured-label,
  .collections-label {
    font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--text-label);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }

  .masonry {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr;
    grid-template-rows: 120px 120px;
    gap: 6px;
    margin-bottom: 40px;
  }

  .masonry-item {
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #e0e0e0;
  }

  .masonry-item.tall {
    grid-row: span 2;
  }

  .masonry-item.wide {
    grid-column: span 2;
  }

  .masonry-item img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
  }

  .collections-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 12px;
  }

  .collection-card {
    position: relative;
    display: block;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .collection-cover {
    aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
    background: #e0e0e0;
  }

  .collection-cover img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
  }

  .collection-title {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 10px;
    left: 10px;
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
  }
</style>
```

### Task 10: Photo Collection Page

**Files:**
- Create: `src/pages/photos/[...collection].astro`

- [ ] **Step 1: Create the collection detail page**

Write `src/pages/photos/[...collection].astro`:

```astro
---
import BaseLayout from '../../layouts/BaseLayout.astro';
import PhotoCard from '../../components/PhotoCard.astro';
import { photoCollections, getCollectionBySlug } from '../../data/photos';
import type { GetStaticPaths } from 'astro';

export async function getStaticPaths() {
  return photoCollections.map((col) => ({
    params: { collection: col.slug },
    props: { collection: col },
  }));
}

const { collection } = Astro.props;
const col = getCollectionBySlug(collection.slug);

if (!col) {
  return Astro.redirect('/404');
}
---

<BaseLayout title={col.title} page="photos">
  <section class="collection-page">
    <h1 class="title">{col.title}</h1>
    <div class="grid">
      {col.photos.map((photo) => (
        <PhotoCard photo={photo} variant="grid" />
      ))}
    </div>
  </section>
</BaseLayout>

<style>
  .collection-page {
    padding-bottom: 60px;
  }

  .title {
    font-size: 22px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--text-title);
    margin-bottom: 24px;
  }

  .grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    gap: 12px;
  }

  @media (min-width: 600px) {
    .grid {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    }
  }
</style>
```

```astro
export interface TimelineEntry {

  date: string;

  <div class="entries">
    {entries.map((entry, i) => (
      <div class="entry">
        <div class="entry-content">
          <div class="entry-title">{entry.title}</div>
          <div class="entry-date">{entry.date}</div>
        </div>
        {i < entries.length - 1 && <div class="line" />}
      </div>
    ))}
  </div>
</div>
```
